name: vgplotr-bundle-build
description: Dev-only tooling to bundle the mosaic JS runtime (mosaic-spec/mosaic-core/duckdb-wasm) into inst/htmlwidgets/lib/mosaic-bundle.min.js. Not part of the R package itself. Versions here must match MOSAIC_VERSION/DUCKDB_WASM_VERSION in build.js and in inst/htmlwidgets/vgplotr.js.
